headline: A drift game where your EV battery is your health bar
text:
A drift game where your EV battery is your health bar & grip is a budget.

Real weight transfer, regen braking, and daily ghost runs—built into a single HTML file (instant load, zero ads).

Can you beat today's dev ghost? 👇
https://kreeda.games/drift/index.html

#gamedev #webdev #indiedev
mediaSuggestion: A 5-second high-frame-rate looping video showing a clean countersteer drift around a tight curve with the ghost car alongside, highlighting the battery regen meter pulsing green.
